dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible lateral margins from the mid-back toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: A localized, irregular cluster of light-grey pixels concentrated on the anterior-right portion of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the slate-grey baseline and the lighter anterior marking.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct cluster of high-contrast, light-toned epidermal marks located on the anterior dorsal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, irregular cluster of light-toned markings on the upper dorsal surface, potentially representing a lesion or scar tissue.
